question: A trader sells an article at price P incurring 10% loss. He later marks it at 1.25P and offers 20% discount. Find his gain or loss percent.
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price in first case = P

Loss = 10%

Marked price = 1.25P

Discount = 20%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 − Loss%)

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 − Discount%)

Gain/Loss % = (Gain or Loss ÷ Cost Price) × 100
